title: 5.4.2 Camera Follow — Worked Example
description: A level wider than the canvas. The camera follows the player, making the world scroll.

steps.title: Read the example
steps.instructions: The ground is 2000px wide — way wider than the 400px canvas. `camera.x = player.x` keeps the player centered as they move.
hints: camera.x and camera.y control the viewport center.

steps.title: Follow with a lag
steps.instructions: Replace `camera.x = player.x` with `camera.x += (player.x - camera.x) * 0.1`. The camera now eases toward the player — much nicer feel.
hints: Lerp: a += (target - a) * t, where t is 0..1 (higher = faster catch-up).

steps.title: Add platforms
steps.instructions: Scatter 5 static platforms across the level at different heights and x positions.

requirements.title: Uses the camera
requirements.description: Reads or writes camera.x or camera.y
